cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.

mechanism: A interprets leaving a routine team duty for its exhibition as a lesson in loyalties and demands the relationship be the stated reason.
confusable: Not only attendance or an excuse: the rearrangement must count as prioritizing A rather than an impersonal emergency.
comparison: Private rescheduling with fee versus public departure reason from a group obligation.
seedUse: Keep D35 sister/exhibition/quiz captain/headache sequence; S05 claiming leadership instruction shapes the correction of B excuse.
